text:
alex: heads-up: deploy-bot flagged RC-42 in the EU canary with a SBOM metadata warning, not a full failure but it's blocking our default canary policy :thinking_face:

maria: what did it flag exactly?

deploy-bot: scan-result: SBOM metadata incomplete for image registry.redwood/rc-42:sha256:abc123
- missing: composer/packaging field
- severity: LOW (policy: soft-fail but requires reviewer ack)
- rule-id: sbom:meta:001

samir: low severity and soft-fail — can we continue with a conditional carveout?

alex: we have a 2hr change window left. prefer not to stall the entire rollout for low sev if we can document and rollback fast.

maria: +1 but need traceability in release notes and a quick plan for pin/rollback. Legal: any compliance objection? @legal

legal: if it's truly metadata-only and not provenance/signature-related, we can allow a timeboxed carveout as long as you attach the investigation notes and a mitigation ticket. No exceptions for missing cosign signatures though.

dana: QA noticed a small mismatch in package list vs SBOM earlier in staging. I created ticket PROD-1307 with diffs and test vectors. We can attach that to the release.

samir: proposal: continue canary to 10% in eu region, enable extra monitoring, tag release notes with "SBOM metadata warning - tracked" and open a hotpatch branch pinned to the same digest. If anything regresses, immediate rollback to previous digest.

alex: sounds reasonable. Add an explicit rollback playbook in the PR and set alerting: error-rate + dependency-checker alerts.

deploy-bot: applied temporary policy override: canary=10% (eu), rollback-if: cpu>200% or p50 latency +15% or #prod-errors>5 in 5m. Override expires in 3h.

maria: I'll update release notes and attach PROD-1307 + SBOM diff. Also pinging infra to keep an eye on quota for quick rollbacks.

qa-bot: preflight: smoke-tests passed on eu canary (5/5). Integration suite queued.

samir: capture decision in the changelog: "RC-42 canary allowed under timeboxed SBOM metadata carveout — mitigation ticket PROD-1307; rollback criteria set."

alex: ok let's move forward. @dana can you take the owner on the mitigation ticket and confirm when cosign/signature checks are green?

dana: on it, will update within 1h and escalate if we see any signature issues.

maria: thanks everyone. tagging this thread for the release notes and audit: /cc @legal @deploy-bot :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: note: please run `./tools/sbom-attach --ticket PROD-1307 registry.redwood/rc-42:sha256:abc123` to attach evidence to the artifact.

alex: done. closing thread when we have the attachment and QA integration results.

maria: last msg: wondering if we should add a permanent rule to treat composer/packaging missing as informational only? follow-up needed for policy owners.
